title: fix(console): moving straight from one object's data page to another's opens the new address's list
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9GPJ8pmbK219Pay95x25Uno)_
Fixes #36577
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化:在数据页(某个对象的 /data 页)直接跳到另一个对象的数据页时，新列表按新地址里的搜索、筛选、排序、分组和快捷筛选打开，不再沿用上一个对象的搜索。
- 为什么做：刚合入的「数据页把列表状态写进地址」留下的缺口，替从一个对象数据页直接跳到另一个对象数据页的用户补上。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是换对象时列表多重新加载一次，或换对象后列表状态读错;只影响数据页，可直接撤回本改动。
- 要你做什么：无

## What changes

`ObjectDataPage` (the bare data page, `/apps/APP/OBJECT/data`) stays mounted when the router moves from one object's data page to another's: the route element carries no key, and `AppContent` keeps the route tree up whenever the new object's metadata is already in scope (the same app's bundle). Its `ListView` was keyed on `listGeneration` alone, and `ListView` takes its search, Filter panel and `uf_FIELD` chip selections once, at mount. So the seed the page already re-read per `OBJECT~GENERATION` was written back into the address, but the list on screen kept the previous object's search and ignored the new address's.

- `ListView` is now keyed on the seed key (`OBJECT~GENERATION`), the pair the seed is already read for: a new object remounts the list on the new address's seed; 「Reset」 to the source still moves the generation and remounts on an empty seed, exactly as before.
- The `uf_FIELD` quick-filter chip selections (ADR-0047) are read with the seed, from the router's address, instead of once per page mount from `window.location.search` (which also handed a later object the first object's chips). A 「Reset」 seed still carries none.

No props, exports or address keys change. `objectViewListUrlState.ts` and `userFilterUrlState.ts` are untouched.

## Tests

New top-level `describe` in the shared harness `ObjectDataPage.openRule-35875.test.tsx` (`objectstack#36577 — moving straight from one object's data page to another's …`), driving the real page and `ListView` under a `MemoryRouter`, navigating with `useNavigate` (no reload):

1. `/data/demo_account?uf__search=Acm` → `/data/demo_contact?uf__search=Glo&uf_stage=won`: the contact list queries `$search: "Glo"` with the `stage = won` chip in `$filter`, the toolbar keyword is `Glo`, and the address keeps both.
2. `/data/demo_account?uf__search=Acm` → `/data/demo_contact`: no contact query carries a search, no keyword is drawn, no `uf__search` is written.

No existing test was changed.

## Acceptance notes

- Measured on `origin/main` c0eecb1f (after PR #36571), before the fix, in the harness above: after the switch the address read `?uf__search=Glo&uf_stage=won`, while both `demo_contact` list queries carried `$search: "Acm"` and no `stage` condition, and the toolbar keyword read `Acm`. The card's premise holds.
- In the running console the page stays mounted only when the new object is already in the route's object scope (no metadata wait between the two routes); when `AppContent` shows the route skeleton in between, the page remounted and read the address anyway. The harness reading is the mounted case; no browser run was made.
- `ui/packages/app-shell` has 2414 test files; the full package suite is far beyond one foreground run here and is left to CI (`Test UI`). Run locally: every `ObjectDataPage*.test.tsx` and every app-shell test file naming `ObjectDataPage`.
